summary: Tested backend and frontend at 390x844 for the Sea Route (A* over OSM water), the skipper Planned route Map tab (auto-draw, handles, Prepare labels on the right line, pin move/redraw, miles), the Shore contact route map and auto-share. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed. Frontend: every requested flow worked. No functional bugs found. There are minor design and quality notes.

minor.issue: The route mostly stays on water, but sampling the drawn lines against z13 OSM tiles found 21/320 (leg 1) and 26/600 (leg 2) samples off the water colour. Most sit at the pin ends (the Picton pin is on land in town, so the leg crosses land to reach water). A few are isolated points mid-route, probably map labels or corner cutting by the 3px cells / 0.25 fallback threshold. Leg Picton->Ship Cove also gets 14 bends, many in tiny steps near Picton, which crowds the handles.
No rate limit. Each call can fetch up to 36 tile.openstreetmap.org tiles from the server (OSM tile usage policy and abuse risk). The in-memory cache has no in-flight dedupe.

integration_issues.issue: With 3 legs and no paths, opening the Map sent 4 POST /sea-route calls instead of 3. It settled on the right paths [3,4,10 bends]. Likely cause: PlannedLegs.setPath uses the legs array from an old render, so when two later-leg responses land before a re-render, one path is overwritten with undefined and that leg is requested again. Harmless today but wasteful. Use a functional update or merge against the latest legs.

design_issues.screen: Planned route > Map tab (opening fit zoom, 390px)
issues: The 'Prepare to anchor' and 'Prepare to return to Dock' boxes overlap each other, pin 3 and the '18 nm' label at the first fit zoom (Mana->Picton->Ship Cove). They separate once zoomed in. Consider hiding or shortening labels when they collide, or a tighter fit.

When GPS points exist, the map fits only the GPS track (here Auckland to Wellington), so the planned route stops sit small with 'Arrive · Returning to Dock' covering pin 3. Consider fitting to track plus route stops.

action_items: Optional: stop the stale legs closure in PlannedLegs.setPath / StopsMap auto-route from re-requesting legs when there are 3+ legs
Optional: stop the Prepare/Arrive labels overlapping each other and the pins at low zoom
Optional: rate-limit /api/sea-route and dedupe in-flight tile fetches
Optional: ShoreMap fit bounds should include the route stops as well as the GPS track
critical_code_review_comments: sea_route.py: if one tile fetch fails, the whole route returns ok:false. That's acceptable, but log which tile failed.

StopsMap auto-route: when ok:false the path is set to [] (a straight line) and never retried. That's intended, but a network error leaves the path undefined, and it is only retried on the next legs change.
share_route: the route stops/lines are validated with Pydantic, lines are capped at 80 points, and the owner check uses the boat owner_id. Good.
BoatPrep routeJson effect: the 4 s debounce works. It PUT /shore/route once on load and again about 4 s after a handle drag (both seen in network logs).

The Leaflet map is not exposed on window; drag handles with page.mouse but filter to handles inside the stops-map-canvas rect (offscreen handles exist in the DOM, and clicking outside closes the dialog).
